_comment: Patch notes shown in the app's What's New dialog. This file is bundled into the exe. CHANGELOG.md is the human-readable source of truth; keep the two in step when a release is cut. Newest version first.

en.headline: Simpler Settings
notes: Removed the unused Display section from Settings.
The app now relies on standard Windows window placement and remains resizable.
Version advanced to 0.4.5.

zh.headline: 简化设置页面
notes: 已从设置中移除未使用的显示器选项。
应用现在使用 Windows 的标准窗口定位方式，并保持窗口可调整大小。
版本已更新至 0.4.5。

en.headline: Download and install updates in the app
notes: Packaged Windows builds can download an update in the app and show its progress.
The downloaded executable is verified against the release SHA-256 before installation.
The app closes and restarts to apply the update. A backup is kept and restored if the new build cannot start.
Older versions need one manual install before they can use in-app downloading and installation.

zh.headline: 在应用中下载并安装更新
notes: Windows 安装版现在可以直接在应用中下载更新并显示进度。
安装前会使用发布清单中的 SHA-256 校验下载的程序。
应用会关闭并重新启动以完成更新。如果新版本无法启动，会保留并恢复旧版本。
旧版本需要先手动安装一次，之后才能使用应用内下载和安装。

en.headline: Seamless waybill sorter switching
notes: Language and theme changes now refresh the Waybill Sorter controls in place, without closing or reopening the app.
Header controls and translated statistic labels keep stable sizes when switching between English and Chinese.
Version advanced to 0.4.3 for the in-app update checker.

zh.headline: 运单排序工具无缝切换
notes: 切换语言或主题时，现在会直接更新运单排序工具中的控件，不再关闭或重新打开应用。
在英文和中文之间切换时，页眉控件和统计标签会保持稳定尺寸。
版本已更新至 0.4.3，供应用内更新检查器使用。

en.headline: Fixed-size language controls
notes: Language and theme changes now update the existing screen in place, without hiding or recreating the app window.
The Language, theme, and Settings controls keep fixed pixel sizes when switching between English and Chinese.
Version advanced to 0.4.2 for the in-app update checker.

zh.headline: 固定语言切换控件尺寸
notes: 切换语言或主题时，现在会直接更新现有界面，不再隐藏或重建应用窗口。
在英文和中文之间切换时，语言、主题和设置控件会保持固定像素尺寸。
版本已更新至 0.4.2，供应用内更新检查器使用。

en.headline: Smoother language switching
notes: Language and theme changes no longer show the interface while its controls are being rebuilt.
The Language, theme, and Settings buttons keep the same size when switching between English and Chinese.
The Settings window keeps a fixed size and stays open when you switch language or theme.
This release also includes the Unlock Files workflow for PDFs and Excel workbooks from version 0.4.0.

zh.headline: 更流畅的语言切换
notes: 切换语言或主题时，不再显示界面控件重建过程中的空白状态。
在英文和中文之间切换时，语言、主题和设置按钮保持相同尺寸。
设置窗口保持固定尺寸，切换语言或主题时也会继续打开。
本版本还包括 0.4.0 中新增的 PDF 和 Excel 工作簿解锁功能。

en.headline: Unlock PDFs and Excel files
notes: The Unlock Files workflow now handles PDFs and Excel workbooks, including file-open passwords and workbook or worksheet protection.
Choose individual files or select a folder to process supported files in its subfolders.
Enter an optional password for encrypted files; unlocked copies, a summary, and a CSV report are saved to a new output folder.
A per-user Windows installer is now available for sharing with colleagues.

zh.headline: 解锁 PDF 和 Excel 文件
notes: 新增通用解锁功能，可处理 PDF 和 Excel 工作簿，包括文件打开密码以及工作簿或工作表保护。
可选择单个或多个文件，也可选择文件夹以处理其中各级子文件夹的支持文件。
加密文件可输入密码；解锁后的副本、摘要和 CSV 报告会保存到新的输出文件夹。
现已支持生成可分享给同事的 Windows 用户级安装程序。

en.headline: Dark mode
notes: New dark mode. Use the button in the top-right corner of the window to switch between light and dark, or choose it in Settings under Appearance.
Your choice is remembered, so the app opens in the scheme you last used.
Every part of the interface is themed, including the scrollbars and the dividers.
The text colours were checked against a readability standard in both modes, and the footer version text - which was slightly too faint to read comfortably - is now darker.

zh.headline: 深色模式
notes: 新增深色模式。使用窗口右上角的按钮即可在浅色与深色之间切换，也可在“设置”的“外观”中选择。
您的选择会被记住，下次打开软件时使用上次选择的模式。
界面各部分均已完成配色适配，包括滚动条与分隔线。
两种模式下的文字颜色都经过可读性标准检查；页脚的版本文本此前略显过淡，现已加深。

en.headline: Header spacing
notes: The Back to Main Menu button now has proper space between it and the section title. They were pressed right up against each other.
The UniTrans logo is no longer shown inside the sections - only on the main menu - which gives the heading and the back button room to breathe.
The Excel Columns button is now exactly the same width as the Choose Excel button above it, so the card lines up properly.

zh.headline: 标题区域间距
notes: “返回主菜单”按钮与页面标题之间现在有合适的间距。此前两者过于贴近。
各功能页面不再显示 UniTrans 标志（仅在主菜单显示），使标题与返回按钮都有更充裕的空间。
“Excel 列设置”按钮现在与上方的“选择 Excel”按钮宽度完全一致，卡片对齐更整齐。

en.headline: Equal-sized buttons
notes: The buttons on the main screen are now all the same size. Previously each one was sized to fit its own wording, so they looked uneven.
Switching between English and Chinese no longer changes the size of any button, and no longer shifts the layout.
This applies to the three main buttons, the buttons down the side of each screen, the Excel Columns button, and the Choose File/Folder buttons.

zh.headline: 按钮尺寸统一
notes: 主界面的按钮现在大小一致。此前每个按钮会按自身文字调整宽度，因此看起来参差不齐。
在中英文之间切换时，按钮尺寸不再改变，界面布局也不会移位。
此修正适用于三个主按钮、各页面侧边的按钮、“Excel 列设置”按钮，以及“选择文件/文件夹”按钮。

en.headline: Interface fixes
notes: Switching between English and Chinese no longer resizes the window or moves it to another screen.
A stray blue box that could appear around a button after clicking has been removed.
There is now a Back to Main Menu button at the top-left of every section, so you can always get back to the start.
Settings now has a Display section where you can choose which monitor the app opens on. The choice is remembered and applies the next time you open the app.
The app no longer extends past the edge of the screen when it opens.
Update checking from the Settings window works as before.

zh.headline: 界面修正
notes: 在中英文之间切换时，窗口不再改变大小，也不会跳到另一个屏幕。
修复了点击后按钮周围偶尔出现的蓝色方框。
每个功能页面的左上角新增“返回主菜单”按钮，随时可以回到起始界面。
“设置”中新增“显示器”部分，可选择软件在哪个屏幕上打开。该选择会被记住，并在下次打开软件时生效。
软件打开时不再超出屏幕边缘。
“设置”窗口中的检查更新功能保持不变。

en.headline: Settings and update checking
notes: New Settings window, reached from the Settings button in the top-right corner. It shows which version you have installed.
You can now check for updates yourself. The app asks the release server whether a newer version exists, and if there is one it shows you what changed and offers a link to download it.
Release notes appear in whichever language you are using the app in.
Update checks never interrupt your work. If there is no internet connection, or the network blocks the release server, the app simply tells you it could not check.
This version does not check for updates by itself - you start the check from the Settings window.

zh.headline: 设置与更新检查
notes: 新增“设置”窗口，可通过右上角的“设置”按钮打开，其中会显示当前已安装的版本。
现在可以手动检查更新。软件会向发布服务器查询是否有新版本；如有，会显示更新内容并提供下载链接。
更新说明会以您当前使用的界面语言显示。
检查更新不会中断您的工作。如果没有网络连接，或网络无法访问发布服务器，软件只会提示无法检查。
此版本不会自动检查更新，需要您在“设置”窗口中手动开始检查。

en.headline: First beta release
notes: Version numbering restarts at 0.1.0. The earlier internal builds were labelled 1.0; no features were removed, the beta simply gets an honest number. The app is now called Unitrans Portal.
Sort waybill PDFs into the same order as the Excel workbook, with a SHA-256 verification that every sorted file is a byte-for-byte copy of the original download.
Create one bulk PDF for printing, with optional separator pages between waybills and digital sequence marks on forms 1 and 4.
Fill blank driver numbers from scanned waybill images.
Unlock PDFs that open but are blocked from editing or printing by permissions-style encryption.
The application now carries a proper icon and version information, so Windows shows which build is installed instead of leaving it blank.

zh.headline: 首个测试版本
notes: 版本号从 0.1.0 重新开始。之前的内部版本标记为 1.0；没有移除任何功能，只是为测试版使用了准确的版本号。软件名称现为 Unitrans Portal。
按 Excel 工作表的顺序整理运单 PDF，并使用 SHA-256 校验每个文件与原始下载完全一致。
可生成用于打印的合并 PDF，并可选在运单之间插入分隔页、在单据 1 和 4 上标注序列号。
从扫描的运单图片中自动填写空白的司机车号。
解锁可以打开但受权限加密限制无法编辑或打印的 PDF。
软件现在带有正式图标和版本信息，Windows 中可直接查看已安装的版本。
